title: North Dakota woman loses $110,000 home improvement claim after breakup with partner
summary_full: After her relationship concluded, Mary Roth pursued the return of over $110,000 she invested in home enhancements. However, the North Dakota Supreme Court determined that she could not secure restitution through an unjust enrichment claim. The ruling underscored that Roth needed to demonstrate an actual financial benefit to the property owner, something her receipts failed to do when it came to increasing the property's market value.
